title: Places to visit
summary: Heritage Centre, 3D-printed house, Watsa stadium, temples, Guindy park, Phoenix Mall.

posts.md:
Whether your parents are visiting IIT Madras or you're planning a weekend with friends, here are some must-visit places.

## Heritage Centre

Want to know the story of IIT Madras?

The **Heritage Centre**, located inside the **Admin Block**, showcases the institute's history through old photographs, artifacts, and exhibits. You can also watch a short film about IIT Madras and learn interesting facts about the campus, its culture, and its wildlife.

**Perfect for:** Parents, alumni, and anyone curious about IITM's journey.

## 3D Printed House
India's first 3D-printed house, built by IITM startup **Tvasta** in just five days.

## Manohar C. Watsa Stadium
Perfect for morning walks, evening runs, or simply enjoying the sunset.

## Centre For Innovation (CFI)

The **Centre for Innovation (CFI)** is IIT Madras' **24×7 student innovation lab**, where students build everything from robots and drones to electric vehicles and rockets.

It's one of the most exciting places on campus if you're interested in engineering, design, and hands-on projects.

**Perfect for:** Students interested in innovation, startups, and maker culture.

## Temples Inside Campus
- Jalakanteswarar Temple – https://maps.app.goo.gl/7777zYj5XPpEGR7h9
- Sri Durga Peeli Amman Temple – https://maps.app.goo.gl/53VazVFmgV6n4Epf8
- Shiva, Vinayaka & Krishna Temple – https://maps.app.goo.gl/EAndnycXUVjZK62u8
- Kailasanathar & Vana Sastha Temple – https://maps.app.goo.gl/Jc97iBNAGUtMRDKD8

## Guindy National Park & Snake Park
Located next to IITM, it's a great place to spot deer, blackbucks, birds, and visit the famous Snake Park.

## Phoenix MarketCity
The go-to place for shopping, movies, restaurants, cafés, and weekend hangouts.
**Senior's Tip**

If you're showing your parents around campus, a simple itinerary is:

**Heritage Centre → 3D Printed House → Watsa Stadium → Phoenix MarketCity**
